items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him down at a club... Kelly's Stables... he asked me did I want to go down to Kelly's Stables with them

ctx.x: Who was At Johnson, and what did he play, and how did you start working with him?
At Johnson was a tenor player. He played Blues, he'd sing the Blues. I worked with him down at a club down at... I can't think of the name of that club. At 42nd...44th Street. Kelly's Stables.
